problem: The design-only amendment centered the seven bowl-y levels on robot-frame y=0 while holding the cube at y=0.12396888434886932 m and requiring every reset to remain outside both frozen 45-degree relation cones. Those requirements cannot jointly support the preregistered minimum half-range of 0.09 m.

exact_geometry.frozen_cone_rule: A reset is LEFT or RIGHT whenever absolute cube-minus-bowl y is at least absolute cube-minus-bowl x, with sign selecting direction.

correction.new_center_basis: Exact V3-B001 control bowl y; chosen from the pre-existing fixture, not from a policy outcome.
correction.seven_level_rule: Select the largest r on the 0.03 m grid for which [y0-r, y0-2r/3, y0-r/3, y0, y0+r/3, y0+2r/3, y0+r] all pass the frozen model-blind gates, where y0=0.12658219039440155 m.
correction.dense_grid_alignment: Integer multiples of 0.01 m displacement about y0, clipped by live support and collision bounds.

claim_boundary: This correction changes only the zero-request calibration coordinate origin needed to keep starts neutral. It does not use model behavior, alter the seven-level spacing, prompts, seeds, success predicate, analysis, or behavioral ceiling.
